column1: # Translations of this plugin's content and messages (i18n: key = this plugin's own id for the text (sent as "<pluginId>.<key>")

column2: Unit attributes: base (tier 1), specialty (tier-1 bonus on the family specialty), tier2 (×), tier2Specialty (extra × on the specialty), growth / specialtyGrowth (× per tier from tier 3).
column3: 兵种属性：「基数」（1 级基准）、「特长加成」（1 级特色属性倍率）、「2 级」（2 级倍率）、「2 级特长加成」（2 级特色属性再乘）、「每级倍率」/「特长每级倍率」（3 级起每级倍率）。

column2: Marching speed in tiles per hour: base (foot units, every tier), cavalry1 (× for tier-1 mounted units), cavalryGrowth (× per mounted tier).
column3: 行军速度（格 / 时）：「基数」是步兵、弓兵（各级相同）；「1 级骑兵倍率」；「骑兵每级倍率」。

column2: Loot per unit = base × tier × family factor.
column3: 载重 =「基数」× 等级 × 兵种系数。

column2: Per unit, with r = total attributes relative to tier 1: total cost = cost × r^costExponent; seconds = seconds × r^timeExponent (before barracks level).
column3: 训练（r = 总属性相对 1 级的倍数）：总花销 =「费用」× r 的「费用指数」次方；用时 =「时长（秒）」× r 的「时长指数」次方（兵营等级修正之前）。

column2: Upkeep per unit per hour (all resources together) = perHour × r^exponent.
column3: 每个兵每小时维持（各资源合计）=「每小时」× r 的「指数」次方（r = 总属性相对 1 级的倍数）。

column2: Training time by barracks level: each level up to linearUntil takes off `step` (additive), each level after multiplies by `factor`.
column3: 兵营等级与训练时间：到「线性到第几级」之前每级减「每级步长」（加法），之后每级乘「之后每级倍率」。

column2: Barracks level needed to train each tier (tierN); tiers without a row are never trained.
column3: 训练每一级兵需要的兵营等级（「1 级」「2 级」……）；没有的等级不能训练。

column2: How the training cost splits over resources, in % per family (partial: only the families given are replaced).
column3: 训练花销在各资源间的分摊（%），按兵种（部分覆盖：只替换写到的兵种）。

column2: How the upkeep splits over resources, in % per family (partial: only the families given are replaced).
column3: 维持开销在各资源间的分摊（%），按兵种（部分覆盖）。
